fullDescription: A professional SaaS workbench design for interviewers and HR managers. Features a triple-column layout with a tech-blue and slate color palette. Optimized for recruitment platforms, fintech, and enterprise dashboards. The design uses high-contrast typography (Plus Jakarta Sans), specific card shadows, and interactive components like a pulsing timer and star-based ratings. Industry focus: HR Tech, Enterprise SaaS, Technical Assessment tools. Key visual features: bento-style grids, micro-interactions for hover states, and clear progress indicators.

structured.summary: A sleek, professional three-column dashboard designed for real-time technical interview management. It features a left navigation with candidate queues, a central workspace for candidate profiles and question management, and a right panel for live session tracking and time-sensitive alerts.

style.description: The style is a modern 'Enterprise Clean' aesthetic using 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for UI elements and 'JetBrains Mono' for numeric data. The primary color is Tech Blue (#2563eb) with a background of Slate-50 (#f8fafc). The design utilizes large border-radii (1.5rem to 2rem) and subtle depth through custom shadows and ring-style focus states.
style.prompt: # Global Styles: Background: #f8fafc (Slate-50); Text Color: #0f172a (Slate-900); Secondary Text: #64748b (Slate-500). # Typography: Primary Font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans'; Weights: 400(Regular), 600(SemiBold), 700(Bold), 800(ExtraBold). Monospace Font: 'JetBrains Mono' for timers. # Color Palette: Primary Blue: #2563eb; Primary Hover: #1d4ed8; Light Blue Accent: #eff6ff; Success Green: #22c55e; Warning Amber: #fbbf24; Border Color: #e2e8f0. # Effects: Card Shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); Report Shadow: 0 10px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); Transition: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). # Components: Buttons use 12px border-radius; Input focus uses blue ring-4 blue-500/10.

layout_and_structure.description: A fixed-height triple-column layout with independent scrolling. Left sidebar (352px) for context, main central area for core tasks, and right utility bar (320px) for session-specific metadata.

prompts.partPt: Left Menu Lateral Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt: Width: 352px; Background: #ffffff; Border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0. Top section: Branding and global category label in 11px uppercase bold slate-400. Navigation: Vertical list of 14px font-size items with 20px gap; active state uses #eff6ff background and #2563eb text. 'Today's Queue' section: Scrollable list of cards; each card 16px radius, border #e2e8f0, containing a 44px avatar and two-line text (Name/Role). Bottom section: Profile switcher with 36px logo and inline editable name/title fields.

Height: 64px; Background: #ffffff; Border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; Flexbox layout with space-between. Left: Page title in 18px Bold Slate-800. Right: Action group with two buttons (Outline #e2e8f0 and Solid #2563eb), padding 12px 24px, 14px bold text.

Padding: 40px; Gap: 40px vertical. Top Section: Candidate Profile Card, 32px padding, white background, #e2e8f0 border. Features 112px rounded-3xl avatar with 4px white border and shadow. Skill tags: Slate-50 background, 10px bold uppercase text. Middle Section: Question Cards; Background white, hover border #93c5fd. Includes sub-panel for 'Guidelines' with 24px padding, slate-50 background, and two-column grid for key points and criteria. Bottom Section: 3-column rating grid for technical/soft skills using HTML5 range sliders with #2563eb accents.

Width: 320px; Background: #ffffff; Border-left: 1px solid #e2e8f0. Top Section: Timer component; #2563eb background, 36px ExtraBold Monospace text with slow-pulse animation (3s opacity shift). Middle Section: Vertical progress timeline; 1px vertical line with 28px circular indicators. Completed steps use #22c55e icons, active step uses #2563eb with ping animation. Bottom Section: Alert box in #fffbeb (Amber-50) with 11px semi-bold body text.

special_ui_components.description: A complex card for structured data entry.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: Background white, border 1px solid #e2e8f0, border-radius 24px, padding 32px. Header: includes category badges (10px, bold, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.1em) and a 5-star rating widget using lucide-icons. Rating stars transition from #e2e8f0 to #fbbf24 on interaction. Detail Panel: nested div with background #f8fafc, border-top 1px solid #f1f5f9, 2-column layout for 'Core Points' and 'Criteria'.

Container: background #2563eb, radius 16px, padding 28px, shadow-xl #dbeafe. Typography: Font 'JetBrains Mono', color #ffffff, size 36px, weight 800. Animation: pulse-slow (keyframe 0%,100% opacity 1; 50% opacity 0.6) with 3s duration. Includes a sub-grid showing labels 'Hours', 'Mins', 'Secs' in 10px white uppercase text.

Layout: Relative container with a 1px vertical spine (#f1f5f9). Steps: 28px circle icons. Completed: Green background, Lucide check icon. Active: Blue background, Lucide play icon, with a concentric pinging ring animation (animate-ping). Inactive: Light gray background, 30% opacity for the entire step group.

special_ui_components.description: Custom range input for qualitative scoring.
special_ui_components.prompt: Track: 6px height, background #f1f5f9, radius 8px. Thumb: Accent color #2563eb. Labeling: 11px bold slate-400 uppercase labels positioned at start, middle, and end of the slider track for semantic reference (e.g., Junior, Mid, Expert).
